about.title: About
about.desc: What Relire is and where your data goes.

about.what: Relire is a close-reading assistant for French learners preparing for TCF Canada. Read real articles, open any word or sentence for an explanation, and practise saying them aloud.
about.privacy: There is no account and no app server. Your articles, vocabulary and recordings stay in this browser. When you use an AI feature, the text or recording goes straight from this browser to the provider you chose, with your own key.
about.scope: Relire is a study aid. It has no mock exams and gives no official scores, and AI feedback is an estimate.

settings.strictAccentsNote: On, an answer is only correct with the right accents. Off, an answer without accents still counts.
settings.dictationSpeedNote: How fast a dictation item is read when you press Listen.
settings.speakAfterCheckNote: After a dictation item is checked, its number is spoken again.

onboarding.label: Getting started
onboarding.welcomeBody: Open an article, tap any word or sentence to see what it means in context, then read it aloud and get feedback on your pronunciation.
onboarding.welcomeNeed: The explanations come from an AI service ({{provider}} by default). You need a free API key; it stays in this browser and is only sent to that service.
onboarding.tryTitle: Try it on a sample article
onboarding.tipWord: Tap a word to see its meaning in context, how to pronounce it, and how the verb is conjugated.
onboarding.tipSentence: Tap a sentence, then Analyze, to see its structure and grammar and to practise reading it aloud.
onboarding.tipSpeak: Save words you want to remember; they come back for review on a schedule.
